ValidationRule.description: Require baseline qualification data when Care Enquiry leads progress beyond Inquiry.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Name = 'Care Enquiry', ISCHANGED(Status), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Inquiry'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Not Admitted') ) ), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(CareOrch_Enquiry_Source__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(CareOrch_Funding_Type__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(CareOrch_Requested_Care_Type__c)), ISBLANK(CareOrch_Target_Admission_Date__c), ISBLANK(CareOrch_Medical_Conditions__c), ISBLANK(CareOrch_Care_Needs__c), ISBLANK(CareOrch_Dietary_Needs__c), ISBLANK(CareOrch_Contact_Information__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complete enquiry source, medical conditions, care needs, dietary needs, contact information, funding type, requested care type, and target admission date before progressing beyond Inquiry.
